abstract: Maintains patient airlift capacity records, medical resuscitation certifications, and life-support tare weights
system_message:
You are the Aeromedical clinical director (MEDDIR). Your operational responsibilities include maintaining patient airlift capacity records, medical resuscitation certifications, life-support tare weights, and blood supply reserves for Pilbara aeromedical staging corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Blood supply reserve（BLOODBNK）
information_points.content:
MEDDIR-BLOODBNK-J78：The Port Hedland Inland Staging Track maintains a standby reserve of 12 units of refrigerated packed red cells.
MEDDIR-BLOODBNK-6WY：The Karratha Coastal Aeromedical Corridor maintains a standby reserve of 8 units of refrigerated packed red cells.
MEDDIR-BLOODBNK-2SI：The Newman Central Plateau Airway maintains a standby reserve of 16 units of refrigerated packed red cells.

information_points.title: Maintains patient airlift capacity records, medical resuscitation certifications, and life-support tare weights（CLINIC）
information_points.content:
MEDDIR-CLINIC-NFN：For the November 2024 operational cycle, the Karratha Coastal Aeromedical Corridor provides a transit patient capacity of 4 patients, does not hold advanced trauma resuscitation team accreditation, and has an intensive care life-support equipment tare weight of 510 kg.
MEDDIR-CLINIC-IPX：For the October 2024 operational cycle, the Karratha Coastal Aeromedical Corridor provides a transit patient capacity of 3 patients, holds advanced trauma resuscitation team accreditation, and carries an intensive care life-support equipment tare weight of 600 kg.
MEDDIR-CLINIC-SCI：For the October 2024 operational cycle, the Newman Central Plateau Airway provides a transit patient capacity of 2 patients, maintains advanced trauma resuscitation team accreditation, and has an intensive care life-support equipment tare weight of 420 kg.
MEDDIR-CLINIC-7Y0：For the October 2024 operational cycle, the Port Hedland Inland Staging Track provides a transit patient capacity of 3 patients, possesses advanced trauma resuscitation team accreditation, and records an intensive care life-support equipment tare weight of 510 kg.
